title: Enterprise Connectivity: assisted payout maximum
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this assisted payout maximum rule to assisted overpayment payout.

## Basis: permitted sum
For assisted overpayment payout, the assisted refund maximum is the smallest of negative receivable magnitude, original payment principal less its returns and refunds floored at zero, and original payment principal multiplied by the matching Support portfolio reduction fraction. The customer may authorize this mechanically determined maximum; any excess balance remains on account.

## Basis Q&A

The customer may authorize this mechanically determined maximum | any excess balance remains on account. |

## Hypothetical payout comparison
Assume hypothetical customer credit of USD 48, remitted funds of USD 500, earlier returns and refunds of USD 470, and a matching support fraction of 0.04. The remaining payment funds are USD 30 and the support bound is USD 20, so the permitted payout maximum is USD 20. Excess customer credit remains on account.
